title: Credit Card Input
content: Build credit card input with auto-formatting. Number field: add spaces after every 4 digits. Card detection: detect Visa, Mastercard, Amex from first digits, show card icon. Expiry field: MM/YY format with auto-slash. CVV field: 3-4 digits based on card type. Luhn validation: validate card number algorithm. Visual card: optional card preview showing entered data.

variants.simple: Create credit card input with formatting and card type detection.
variants.detailed: Build credit card input with auto-formatting. Number field: add spaces after every 4 digits. Card detection: detect Visa, Mastercard, Amex from first digits, show card icon. Expiry field: MM/YY format with auto-slash. CVV field: 3-4 digits based on card type. Luhn validation: validate card number algorithm. Visual card: optional card preview showing entered data.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive credit card input with formatting and validation. Number field: auto-format with spaces (4242 4242 4242 4242), max 16-19 digits based on card type, inputmode="numeric" for mobile keyboard. Card type detection: detect from first digits (4=Visa, 51-55/22-27=Mastercard, 34/37=Amex, 6011/65=Discover), show recognized card brand icon dynamically. Expiry field: MM/YY format, auto-insert "/" after 2 digits, validate month 01-12, validate not expired, inputmode="numeric". CVV/CVC field: 3 digits for most cards, 4 for Amex, position hint (front for Amex, back for others), inputmode="numeric", type="password" or text with toggle. Cardholder name: optional, uppercase transform, alphabetic only with spaces. Luhn algorithm: validate card number checksum on blur, show error if invalid. Visual feedback: green border/check on valid, red on invalid. Card preview: optional visual credit card showing entered data updating live, flip animation to show CVV side. Single line layout: all fields in row on desktop, stack on mobile. Autofill support: autocomplete attributes (cc-number, cc-exp, cc-csc, cc-name). Tokenization ready: structure for Stripe Elements or similar integration. Security: never log card numbers, mask in any error reporting. Accessibility: clear labels, error messages linked with aria-describedby. Save card option: checkbox to save for future (with security disclaimer).
